materialChange.finding: When CURRENT_KEY was missing but IndexedDB held a recoverable backup, the first default render synchronously wrote CURRENT_KEY before asynchronous backup hydration. A refresh in that window could make the next boot prefer the newly written default and strand the IndexedDB backup.
materialChange.fix: Fresh/missing localStorage is now treated as a recovery state until IndexedDB is checked. Existing IndexedDB progress is mirrored into localStorage; only an actually empty backup establishes the new default save. IndexedDB/open failures fall back to localStorage rather than dropping the save.
materialChange.compatibility: Additive/backward-compatible; no schema reset, currency change, catalog-ID filtering, or player-data migration.

Existing GitHub branch workflows provide CI and visual/catalog browser QA, but no Workstream-13-owned live persistence transaction flow was available without a shared workflow change that must be coordinated through Workstream 15.

openReleaseRisks.evidence: App buy() performs owned/star/coin prechecks outside the functional setSave updater; the updater itself subtracts/adds without rechecking current state or a durable transaction receipt. The capture guard protects normal rapid DOM clicks but is not durable exactly-once semantics for non-DOM replay or concurrent contexts.
